kind_of_thing.quote: Okra (US: , UK: ), Abelmoschus esculentus, known in some English-speaking countries as lady's fingers, is a flowering plant in the mallow family native to West Africa.

extinct.why: The sources describe okra as a currently cultivated flowering plant, so it is still living.

kind_of_plant.quote: Cultivated in tropical, subtropical, and warm temperate regions around the world for its edible green (red in some cultivars) seed pods, okra is used in the cuisines of many countries.
